caption: The drawing depicts a box-shaped object that appears to be an ornate lamp or lantern. The primary color of the main body is black, adorned with elaborate decorative patterns in colors such as red, green, yellow, pink, and orange, featuring stylized floral or leaf designs. The front of the lamp has a large circular glass lens showing the interior lamp and a visible flame. Above the lens, there is a rectangular section that reads in yellow letters, "KELLY LAMP COMPANY Rochester N Y." On the left side of the lamp, there is a framed rectangular portrait of a man with gray hair and a beard, wearing a black coat, white shirt, and black bow tie, set against a blue background. The overall composition is centered, and the drawing is bordered with an off-white or cream-colored background. In the lower-left corner, the name "JESSIE M. YOUNGS" is printed in black.
title: Locomotive Headlight
